title: WHAT TO MINE?

body:
(Read Changelog for extra info on items. [Showcase Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tlvTodW5v34))
# What To Mine?
Based off of [MAU MAKAN APA?](https://www.labirhin.art/maumakanapa) by [Labirhin](https://www.youtube.com/@Labirhin)

This mod adds Items/Features from the Web Series [MAU MAKAN APA?](https://www.labirhin.art/maumakanapa) Like:

<details>
<summary>Some Items</summary>

![Minecraft Tempe Texture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1bcc3601f109d7479dd7277add67e229658e6263.png)

Tempe

![Minecraft "Batas" (Limits) Model/Texture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dec5da98a0d314b4b20c8571ddf08f02cdea44c5.png)

"Limits" (Batas)
</details>

It would be awesome to have suggestions!

Discord Username: kittymastr

I may forget about this mod existing cuz I forget things easily.

So far the Main items added are:

[Tempe](https://maumakanapa.wiki.gg/wiki/Tempe): 7 Nutritional Value, 0.7 Saturation.
Splitter: Splits items into 2 different items.

[Limits](https://maumakanapa.wiki.gg/wiki/Material_Limits) (Block): An absurdly durable material.

["Limits"](https://maumakanapa.wiki.gg/wiki/Material_Limits) (Mug): Its a mug.

Jaya Ablocki: Its a block, thats orange. [Jaya Abadi](https://maumakanapa.wiki.gg/wiki/Jaya_Abadi).

Spacetime [OAVI](https://maumakanapa.wiki.gg/wiki/OAVI): A cool thing, idk. You can teleport with it or something.
